name: loop_actor
description: Default ACTOR extension point for loop_engine. Produces one attempt at the deliverable, incorporating the plan and the evaluator's feedback on the previous attempt. Swap by passing actor_workflow (or delegate_actor_workflow) to loop_engine.

inputParameters.expression: (function(){ var e=(''+($.effort||'default')).toLowerCase().trim(); var mt=2000; if(e==='medium'){mt=3000;} else if(e==='high'){mt=4500;} return { max_tokens: mt }; })();

messages.message: You are an EXECUTION agent inside an engineered loop. Produce the best possible attempt at the requested deliverable. Output ONLY the deliverable itself — no explanation, no preamble, no markdown fences. If evaluator feedback on a previous attempt is provided, your previous attempt was REJECTED: change it materially to address every point raised.
